findings.reason: without a resolvable path the node's fence refuses the one file it must edit, and the lander skip cannot be implemented at all.
findings.text: s13's write-path list ends with "the lander module that selects landing candidates", which is a description rather than a path; the dispatch fence is derived from a node's write paths, so an entry that names no file grants no write and the node cannot change the lander

findings.reason: the population is the input to the whole replay, and a filter that selects nothing makes the record unobtainable until the plan states which ledger facts constitute having landed.
findings.text: s14 defines its population as "the ledger rows with a landed outcome", but `outcome` on a committed ledger record is free prose, not a landed flag: of the 112 rows dispatched by session `829e5a4a-6870-4aec-876d-ba2efb1b5ecf` that carry a plan, all 112 record `outcome: ""`, and a sampled landed implement row (`r-20261111T182122414790-anchored-server-starts-inside-the-snapshot`, plan workers-spend-fewer-tokens-per-landed-node, section §10) carries `outcome: ""` with `gate: "passed"` and a landed commit, so a filter on a "landed outcome" returns no rows and the ten-section draw has no population

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — s13's write paths include "the lander module that selects landing candidates", which names no path and so resolves to no file.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — s13 names two negative controls (lander skip removed → landing attempt; reflex skip removed → a review composed, proving the run review-eligible), and s14's control is a replicate clive run whose same-arm paired interval must be reported and which forces a "not separated" verdict for any overlapping arm.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — s14's record, assignment file and figure directory sit under `docs/evidence/fragments/workers-spend-fewer-tokens-per-landed-node/` and `docs/figures/paired-replay`, and each log lives under the run directory; no scratch or node-local temporary path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the flag `--measure-only` and the `measured` ledger outcome describe the mechanism, and no plan label, section number or ticket identifier is carried into a symbol or file name.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — s14's population is "ledger rows with a landed outcome", but the ledger's `outcome` field is free prose and is empty on every landed row of the named session, so the stated query selects nothing.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s13 delivers the measurement-run mode and s14 delivers the paired replay record; each closes on one verdict, and s14's sixty dispatches are the means to its record rather than a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s14's `depends-on` names s13 and the declaration carries it (`plan-section-depends-on` maps `s14` to `workers-spend-fewer-tokens-per-landed-node#s13`); s13 declares no upstream it needs, because the dispatch flag, reflex skip and lander skip are all built inside it.
